nodes.label: Project CLAUDE.md (graphify rules)
nodes.rationale: Instructs Claude to query the existing graphify-out/ graph first for codebase questions instead of raw grep/GRAPH_REPORT.md, because query/path/explain return a much smaller scoped subgraph.

nodes.label: AppImageBuilder.yml
nodes.rationale: Builds a custom libXft 2.3.9 before packaging because system libXft 2.3.3 crashes the app on startup when an emoji font is installed; strips ELF debug symbols afterward to trim roughly 10MB off the AppDir.

nodes.label: PyInstaller packaging
nodes.rationale: Some antivirus engines (including Windows Defender) flag PyInstaller-packaged executables as trojans because PyInstaller has previously been abused to package malicious code; such reports can be safely ignored.

nodes.label: Priority List / Priority Mode
nodes.rationale: Lets the user control which games are mined first (Priority List) and the fallback order for everything else (Priority Mode), keeping mining focused on wanted drops.

nodes.label: Same-account dual-watch warning
nodes.rationale: Watching a stream in the browser (or by any other means) on the same account the miner uses causes Twitch to report false progress and can get the miner stuck, so concurrent use of the same account elsewhere is discouraged.

nodes.label: TDM project goals and scope
nodes.rationale: TDM is scoped to stream-less Twitch drops mining only, for a single managed account, as a lightweight background helper with no guarantee of unattended operation, no Docker/remote deployment, and no channel-points or third-party-site mining.
